# A recursive component whose function reads its props is refused on
# bubbletea, with a position, rather than emitted: bubbletea makes a
# component's functions the Model's by splicing the component where it is
# written, and a recursion is never spliced, so the function read a prop
# nothing bound (`undefined: n`).
#
# The same program builds on fyne, which keeps an instance of its own.

! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea --out out app.sngl
stderr 'app.sngl:4:5: the recursive component "step" declares "lbl", which reads its props'

sngl generate --lang go --platform fyne --out out2 app.sngl

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

component step(n int) node {
    func lbl() string {
        return "s{n}"
    }
    vbox {
        text(value=lbl())
        if n > 0 {
            step(n=n - 1)
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var depth = 2
    vbox {
        button #b(text="+", @click { depth = depth + 1 })
        step(n=depth)
    }
}

window {
    main
}
